actual: Current MCP tools return oversized payloads by default: qe_experiment_list includes full result_metrics for up to 50 experiments; qe_experiment_get selects all qe_experiments columns including full JSONB fields; qe_custom_evo_get_task returns all loops with full config_json, metrics_json, and agent_analysis. A 10-loop task can return hundreds of KB to tens of MB, and a 50-experiment list can potentially return 2.5MB to 100MB.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.

evidence_uris: User-provided analysis: qe_experiment_list selects result_metrics; qe_experiment_get uses SELECT *; qe_custom_evo_get_task returns all loop JSONB fields; qe_evolution_service.py comment notes enhanced_metrics can overflow context when accumulated across loops.
expected: MCP list and default detail endpoints should return compact summaries by default: scalar columns and required identifiers only, no full result_metrics/metrics_json/config_json/agent_analysis unless explicitly requested. Cross-loop comparison should use a compact scalar comparison endpoint/detail level, with full enhanced metrics, loop config, loop metrics, and LLM analysis fetched only on demand. LoopbackApiClient should enforce a response-size guardrail or truncation warning for oversized MCP payloads.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
reproduce_command: Call MCP tools qe_experiment_list, qe_experiment_get, or qe_custom_evo_get_task on QE evolution data containing enhanced_metrics/stock_trades; observe multi-MB JSON payloads and token explosion.
title: QE MCP experiment APIs return massive JSON payloads
